subject: Purchase envelope: PO fields, net terms, and staged billing policy
messages:
From: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@acme-med.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-med.com
Date: 2026-02-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: PO requirements and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi David,

Quick intro — I'm Elena on Acme's procurement side. We're close to finalizing SOW but need to lock the procurement-side constraints before procurement routing:

- Our AP team requires a single PO per legal entity that includes purchase_order_id, billing_entity_code, and GL account mapping.
- Payment terms: standard net45 but we have an internal policy that allows net30 for committed annual contracts.
- Invoice cadence: primary preference is monthly invoices; however, for large milestone payments we sometimes accept staged monthly plus a final reconciliation.

Attached is our PO template (Acme_PO_template.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO with those header fields and whether discount tiers are conditional on net terms or invoice cadence?

Also: do you require a single consolidated invoice per PO or do you support multi-invoice releases tied to PO line items?

Thanks — if easier, we can schedule a 30-min call this week.

Elena Marquez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Medical
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@acme-med.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the template. Looping in Vanessa (Sales Ops) and Priyom (Finance) so we can confirm the operational pieces.

Short answers up front:
- We can accept the PO header fields you listed (purchase_order_id, billing_entity_code, GL mapping). We map those into our billing system and Echo them on every invoice.
- Discount tiers: we can offer a 15% seat/usage discount for a 12-month committed contract. That discount requires net45 or better and a consolidated annual commitment (or equivalent ARR).
- Invoice cadence: default is monthly invoices per PO, with the option for staged releases (monthly + milestone) if the PO explicitly lists line-item milestones and amounts.

Operational asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the exact GL account codes and whether Acme needs vendor-tax-id on the PO header.
2) If you want staged invoices, include explicit line-item milestones and payment percentages on the PO.
3) For discounts tied to annual commitment, we need the contract term on the PO or an attached contract referencing the PO.

If helpful, I can propose a short mutual action plan that lists who signs what and the invoice schedule. Vanessa / Priyom — can you confirm any Finance caveats (e.g., minimum invoice amount for monthly releases, early-pay incentives)?

Best,
David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@acme-med.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-med.com
Date: 2026-02-14T08:52:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and billing cadence for Redwood engagement

David — appreciate the quick reply. A few clarifying points from procurement after reviewing internally:

> From Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com> and Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
> Thank you for the template — we will need the vendor tax id and preferred remit-to address added to the PO header.

Acme notes:
- We will supply GL codes and confirm whether vendor tax id is required per entity; can you accept vendor-tax-id as an attachment if our ERP won't include it as a PO header?
- For the discount, procurement needs a written condition: 15% off list if Acme signs for 12 months at the target ARR of $360k. If net30 requested by Finance, discount will be evaluated but may drop to 10%.
- Regarding multi-invoice releases: procurement prefers monthly line-item releases. We can structure one master PO with numbered releases (PO-0001-R1, PO-0001-R2, etc.) to link invoices.

Attached is a short procurement_requirements.pdf with our legal team's preferred language around PO releases and invoice acceptance criteria.

Can Redwood confirm you can write invoice PDFs that include the PO release number and that your system can accept incremental releases against a master PO?

Thanks,
Elena
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@acme-med.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: PO release pattern, net terms, and discount conditioning (summary)

Elena — thanks, team. Summarizing what we can commit to operationally so procurement and finance have a single source of truth:

- PO header fields: Redwood will require purchase_order_id (master PO), PO_release_number (if incremental), billing_entity_code, and vendor_tax_id. If vendor_tax_id is not present on the PO, Acme may supply it as a PDF attachment on the first invoice — Redwood will accept that workflow.

- Invoice cadence and format: Redwood will issue monthly PDF invoices referencing the master PO and the PO_release_number. Invoices will include GL mapping lines per your supplied codes. For milestone/staged payments, Redwood will accept explicit numbered releases that tie to invoice line items.

- Net terms and discounts: We can accept net45 as standard. Discounting approved as follows: 15% discount if Acme signs a 12-month commitment at >= $360,000 ARR and pays net45; if Acme requests net30, discount will be 10% (reduced). Any net90 or extended terms will negate the discount unless an early-pay arrangement is pre-authorized by Redwood Finance.

- Minimum invoice amount: Redwood Finance requests a minimum monthly invoice of $2,500 for staged releases; below that we may consolidate until the minimum is reached.

Action items:
1) Elena: confirm GL codes and whether vendor_tax_id will be on PO or attached.
2) Acme legal: confirm acceptance of PO-release language in procurement_requirements.pdf.
3) Vanessa/Priyom: I'll send a short mutual_action_plan.docx that lists signatories, expected invoice schedule, and the HubSpot deal id (ACME-HP-4821).

If all good, we can prepare the SOW + contract and proceed to DocuSign.

Thanks —
David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
